title: eqty.lineage component configuration
description: Settings for one EQTY lineage recorder component inside NeMo Relay.

manifest_dir.description: Directory manifests are written to, resolved relative to Relay's working directory. One manifest per session, named by session id.

deny_globs.description: Paths whose bytes are withheld from the file node and from the tool payloads named against them, and nothing further: a shell command naming no path is outside it, and so is the model conversation that a read's result travelled into. A matching file still becomes a graph node carrying its path and its true content CID, computed before redaction. Provenance does not require publication; treat this as a floor, not a guarantee.

max_content_bytes.description: Content larger than this is recorded by CID and metadata, without storing its bytes. Blobs are inlined into the manifest as base64, so a stored payload costs about 4/3 of its length.

provider_manifests.description: Gateways asked, at export, for the manifest they signed for each model call. Each manifest is merged into the session's whole, and the call is joined to it by the x-nemo-relay-request-id Relay sent upstream. Off unless configured.

base_url.description: Base URL of the gateway's /integrity routes, for example http://localhost:4000.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable holding the gateway key, read by the Relay process. Use the variable Relay takes the agent's key from (OPENAI_API_KEY for nemo-relay codex), so both present the same key. Omit for a gateway that serves manifests without one.

models.description: Model name globs this gateway is asked about. Empty means every model. The gateway key is sent with each request, so list only models that are served through it.
